extensionDescription.message: Block YouTube Shorts, Reels, TikTok, and distracting feeds in Safari with per-site controls.

tagline.message: Block YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Facebook Reels, plus Explore and trends on X. Block TikTok entirely. Lock your settings with Strict mode for 24 hours.

stepEnable.message: Turn on Slowth and allow it on every website

strictHelp.message: For 24 hours, enabled restrictions cannot be turned off. You can add restrictions, but cannot enable whole-site blocking.

strictEnableConfirm.message: For 24 hours, enabled restrictions cannot be turned off. You can add restrictions, but cannot enable whole-site blocking.

modesExplained.message: Strict mode and per-site modes explained

strictGuide.message: For 24 hours, enabled restrictions cannot be turned off. You can add restrictions, but cannot enable whole-site blocking. The timer survives restarts and force-quits.

strictAdvice.message: Turn it on when willpower alone isn't enough. Leave it off if you just want a soft nudge.

modeOffHelp.message: The site loads as usual. Slowth does nothing.

modeShortsHelp.message: Blocks YouTube Shorts, Instagram/Facebook Reels, or X Explore and trends. The rest of the site keeps working.

modeFeedHelp.message: Also stops the endless home feed after a few screens. Instagram additionally covers Explore, Stories, and more Reels surfaces.

modeAllHelp.message: Visiting the site shows a friendly blocked page instead.
